verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers programmatic access through an official MCP server, which lets an agent read and change collections, requests, environments and teams and send real HTTP requests. It also has a CLI that runs tests, automates monitoring and manages collections. There is no documented public REST/GraphQL management API, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on all candidate paths, so parity with the UI is not shown. Missing for 10: a documented public management API with an OpenAPI spec, evidence of UI-to-API parity (e.g. admin dashboard/server config, user management, AI features, settings), and independent corroboration.
